context.body: David therefore departed from there and escaped to Adullam’s cave. When his brothers and all his father’s house heard it, they went down there to him.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: Family, distressed people, debtors, and the discontented gather to David; he places his parents in Moab before Gad directs him back to Judah.
observations.label: A company gathers around the fugitive: textual observation

observations.body: The passage keeps David, his family, four hundred followers, the king of Moab, and Gad, Adullam, Mizpeh of Moab, the stronghold, and Judah, gathering, protecting parents, waiting, receiving a prophetic direction, and departing visible within David's story or later memory.
observations.label: A company gathers around the fugitive: action, promise, or consequence

observations.body: David, his family, four hundred followers, the king of Moab, and Gad · Adullam, Mizpeh of Moab, the stronghold, and Judah · gathering, protecting parents, waiting, receiving a prophetic direction, and departing · a hunted man becomes captain of a vulnerable company
observations.label: Relationships named in 1 Samuel 22:1–5

payload.posture: Read 1 Samuel 22:1–5 as its own flight, covenant, and restraint David setting before carrying its language into another source.
payload.tension: The source places a hunted man becomes captain of a vulnerable company inside this David setting without explaining every motive, transition, or later consequence.
